workload_a_isolated_neural_perception.description: Sequential stages of unprompted Mask2Former instance segmentation from raw bytes to mask instances

operations_included: HTTP request deserialization and Base64 image payload extraction
Image byte validation and Laplacian blur variance calculation
Candidate coordinate parsing and bounding-box mask generation
Visual disagreement overlay rendering and Base64 PNG encoding
LabelCourt rule-based spatial and boundary debt evaluation
Deterministic canonical SHA-256 evidence receipt creation

Deep feature extraction or GPU tensor operations

workload_d_integrated_perception_to_verd.explanation: The current ProofCausality AI API routes do NOT wire the neural Mask2Former forward pass into a single live HTTP request. Mask2Former inference operates offline in batch perceptual evaluations (evaluation/benchmarks/genuine_model_benchmark.py). Consequently, no measured end-to-end HTTP latency exists for a combined image-upload-to-neural-inference-to-verdict route. Combining Workload A and Workload C would be synthetic and is strictly avoided to preserve measurement integrity.

scientific_disclosures: Workload A and Workload C represent separate execution paths with different computational requirements.
Workload C API p50 latency (~98 ms) is FASTER than Workload A neural inference alone (~130-140 ms) precisely because Workload C does NOT execute neural inference.

The Rust SIMD kernel achieves a 3.1x-11.4x microbenchmark speedup on pure pixel operations, but because kernel computation takes <0.01 ms, it does not materially alter total API or model inference latency.
